newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Rates rise on one-month to one-year Saudi t-bills.
newsitem.headline: Rates rise on one-month to one-year Saudi t-bills.

text.p: Yields rose on one-month to one-year Saudi treasury bills worth two billion riyals offered by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency, bankers said on Tuesday.

The yield on 35-day bills, maturing on April 24, rose to 5.3584 percent from 5.3332 on last week's 28-day bills. The 91-day bills, maturing on June 19, yielded 5.5075 percent from last week's 5.4836 percent.
The rate on 182-day bills, maturing on September 18, rose to 5.6509 from 5.6097 percent. The yield on 364-day paper, maturing on March 19, 1998, increased to 6.0077 percent from 5.9295.
The treasury bills were priced at 99.48174, 98.62695, 97.22266 and 94.27344 respectively.

One-month interbank deposits were quoted at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent, three-month funds were at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent, six months were at 5-13/16, 11/16 percent and one-year deposits were quoted at 6-1/8, six percent.
